messages.bing: I am a US beginner starting with no equipment. I need to make two milk-based espresso drinks each morning, sequentially if needed, from whole beans. My hard ceiling is $800 for the complete equipment setup, before tax and shipping; spending that much is not a goal. Cover espresso-suitable grinding, espresso brewing, milk steaming, and necessary basic accessories or built-in equivalents, with US household compatibility. Integrated machines and separate components are both welcome; manual steaming is fine. Prioritize enjoyable, consistent drinks, approachable workflow, manageable cleaning, dependable equipment, and confidence in the actual seller and recourse. Saving money matters, but worthwhile improvements can justify paying more. Please return competitive complete setups and useful component alternatives, including less expensive choices with similar expected satisfaction. I can combine compatible offers across providers. Explain material seller, variant, or functionality uncertainties without treating ordinary missing specifications as disqualifying.

selection_reason: Select plan_1: disclose the real combined ceiling and satisfaction criteria to both providers while requesting competitive alternatives. limitations: No catalogs are visible, so these forecasts are qualitative; no product, price, or seller assessment is possible yet.
Providers control returned membership and order. Requests for breadth and value cannot guarantee either.
There is one round, so unavailable alternatives or incomplete coverage cannot be repaired through follow-up.
